text: The 2-sphere S² can be defined as a HIT with constructors:
choices: N, S (poles) and merid(a):N=S for all a:S¹ (same as ΣS¹)
base:S² and surf:refl=refl (a 2-cell constructor at base)
a point and two paths between it
explanation: S² := {base:S², surf:refl_base = refl_base : base=base}. The surface constructor surf is a 2-path (path between paths). Equivalently, S² = ΣS¹ = suspension of S¹.
